to_five: a1 (4): hs watch --path: when the path changed at or before the synced base and the wait would otherwise block, print 'already in your files: #58 pm /CHANGE-REQUEST.md' and exit 0 (or warn up front), so a wait never blocks on something you already have

a2 (4): `hs land` should always split: land files outside /.hsreview immediately and update the workspace proposal to cover only the protected paths (P1 = /CONTRACTS.md only), instead of tying every file in the workspace to the open proposal.

a3 (4): hs land (or the running hs watch) should auto-re-land a provisional land that gets undone by a reorg, keeping the same --check, and report `#51 re-landed as #N`, so an undo never needs the author to notice.
